items.caption: A modern redraw of a proposed early graph interpreted as 視, with an eye above a standing figure. This reading distinguishes it from a comparable form read as 見, whose figure is seated.
items.alt: Black archaic-style drawing with an eye-like shape above a standing human figure.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the proposed early pictographic form and its scholarly distinction from 見; the image is a modern redraw rather than an ancient inscription.

limitations.text: The figure-and-eye reading is a scholarly interpretation, and individual archaic graphs may remain disputed. The illustration is a modern redraw, not an excavated inscription image.
